ats_analyzer_agent.name: ATS Analyzer Agent
ats_analyzer_agent.description: Analyzes the match between a resume and job description. Produces an ATS compatibility score (0-100), identifies matching keywords, missing keywords, skill gaps, and provides a detailed breakdown.

resume_optimizer_agent.name: Resume Optimizer Agent
resume_optimizer_agent.description: Takes a resume and job description, then produces optimized resume sections with before/after comparisons and improvement suggestions.

outreach_writer_agent.name: Outreach Writer Agent
outreach_writer_agent.description: Generates personalized outreach materials including cover letters and LinkedIn messages based on resume and job description.

interview_coach_agent.name: Interview Coach Agent
interview_coach_agent.description: Predicts likely interview questions and provides STAR-method response frameworks, key talking points, and tailored interview tips.
